brief.symptoms: The async producer reports an unexpected success after the broker is restarted, causing messages to be lost and the shutdown to hang.
brief.evidence:
unexpected successes 35 or errors 0
timeout
1 empty values
hints: The producer is still reporting successes even though the broker has been restarted.
Look at the broker restart handling logic in the async producer.
The fix adds a special case for a management message that signals shutdown.
brief.lesson: When a broker restarts while messages are in flight, the async producer must detect the shutdown signal and not treat the in-flight management message as a successful delivery.
